name: Mobile WebView Guidance — Context Switch Recommended
task: The SauceLabs MyDemoApp on the booted Android emulator has a WebView screen accessible from the menu (called 'WebView'). Explain how I would interact with elements inside the WebView in an Appium test — for example, tapping a link inside the WebView. Include the native-to-web context boundary, how to enumerate/switch contexts, what selector types apply before and after the switch, and when to switch back. Do not create files or Maestro YAML.
passCriteria: Explains that mcp__maestro__inspect_view_hierarchy / inspect_screen / Maestro doesn't descend into WebView DOM
Mentions that web-style selectors (CSS / DOM) work inside WebView context, native selectors outside
Mentions switching back to native context for native controls after WebView interaction
Does not create files or Maestro flows for an explanation-only request
failCriteria: Claims you can use mcp__maestro__inspect_view_hierarchy / inspect_screen to read WebView DOM
Suggests authoring a Maestro YAML flow for WebView interaction
Creates test code or project files instead of answering the approach
prereq: SauceLabs MyDemoApp on Android emulator. Agent may navigate to find WebView screen.
